reader_notes: Pilot reading, to test the protocol (I1). Read from the note text, bars 1-22. The reader knew Dreyfus's map of this piece (ch. 1), so this reading is not independent of it; the test is whether the protocol's categories reproduce such a map, not whether the reading agrees by chance. x = C D E F D E C (seven sixteenths from 1:1.25 to 1:2.75); x-INV is its melodic inversion; the eighth-note figure G C B C that follows x in the right hand at 1:3 is called y.

opening.leader_meanwhile: free counterpoint: the eighths y (G C B C) against x in the bass
opening.notes: Bar 2 repeats the pair on G (x in the right hand at 2:1.25, in the bass at 2:3.25).

voices.0: x, y; x on G, y
voices.1: x (8 below, 2 beats later); x on G

members.reason: The bass now leads with x on G (7:1.25) and the right hand follows two beats later (7:3.25); bar 8 continues on D in the bass and on A in the right hand. The voices' roles are exchanged.

voices.0: a chain of x-INV (eight-note form) falling by step each half bar: A G F E G F A, G F E D C E D F, E D C B A C B D, C B A G F# A G B (bars 3-4); then cadential figuration in G
voices.1: eighths rising in tenths under the chain (bars 3-4), x on D (5:1.25), cadential bass D-G

members.reason: The chain of x-INV is in the bass (11:1.25 Bb A G F A G Bb ..., falling to 12:4.75), the eighths in the right hand; minor keys; x on E in the right hand at 13:1.25 where x on D stood in bar 5. Cadence in a at 15:1.

operations: INVERT (the chain is built from x, rising, instead of x-INV, falling)
members.reason: The right hand chains x upward (C D E F D E C, D E F G E F D … to 20:2.75) over falling eighths in the bass: the mirror of beta. It breaks off in bar 20, where the closing passage takes over.

elaborations.function: link from G (end of alpha's member) to d (start of beta's member)
elaborations.material: x-INV in both voices, in parallel sixths

elaborations.function: link from a back toward C
elaborations.material: x and x-INV in one voice against a held note in the other, alternating every half bar
x in the bass (20:3.25), cadential figuration

cadences.reason: D2 (6:4.5) to G (7:1.25 in the bass's x, the right hand on G4 at 7:1).
E3 (14:4.5) to A3 (15:1), right hand on A4.
G2 (21:4.5) to C (22:1), right hand closing on C5 above E4 G4.

returns.what: the opening (alpha) restated in G, voices exchanged
beta restated in d-a, voices exchanged
beta in the tonic, mirrored (the chain built from x rising)

also: double (the two segments return with voices exchanged)

notes: About 14 of the 22 bars are members of the two paradigms (1-8 and 11-14, and 19-20 in part); the rest is elaboration and the close. The reading reproduces Dreyfus's map (Fig. 1.2) segment for segment, including the aborted mirror in bars 19-20.
